config.judge: 结果集等价（列名/行序/别名不参与，数值 1e-6 相对容差）+ 列覆盖
config.note: CI 门禁锚点（20 题、等距取样）。它不是对外口径——对外口径是全量，只用来回答"这一次有没有退步"。只许人工更新。

items.question: 咱们库里现在一共收了多少本书啊？
items.task: 单表计数，dim_book 一行一本，直接 COUNT(*)
items.answer: 当前库中共收录 250 本书。

judge.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book
judge.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book

items.question: 人民文学出版社出的书咱们收了多少本？
items.task: 出版社是自由文本，先精确匹配再计数；模糊匹配要用 LIKE
items.answer: 人民文学出版社出版的书在库中共有38本。

judge.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book WHERE publisher = '人民文学出版社'
judge.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book WHERE publisher = '人民文学出版社'

items.question: 收藏这个动作一共发生了多少次？
items.task: 收藏=加入书架，三种状态都算；只算想读要加 status='want'
items.answer: 收藏动作共发生 2,532 次。

judge.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 收藏总次数 FROM fact_shelf
judge.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 收藏次数 FROM fact_shelf

items.question: 评论区一共攒了多少条评论？
items.task: 评论条数不等于评论人数，1976 条只来自 99 人
items.answer: 评论区共攒了1,976条评论。

judge.sql: SELECT COUNT(comment_id) AS 评论总条数 FROM fact_comment
judge.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 评论条数 FROM fact_comment

items.question: 哪个分类的书最多？给我前五名
items.task: 分组计数后排序取前五，文学小说 139 本断层第一
items.answer: 文学小说以139本位居分类书籍数首位，明显多于其他分类。

judge.sql: SELECT category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5
judge.gold_sql: SELECT category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

items.question: 各个分类的书都卖多少钱？按平均定价从高到低排
items.task: price 有 0.2 元这类脏值和 NULL，先 WHERE price > 1 再求均值
items.answer: 艺术设计类平均定价最高，为100.2，语言文化类最低，为21

judge.sql: SELECT category AS 分类, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS 平均定价, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book WHERE price > 1 GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(price) DESC
judge.gold_sql: SELECT category AS 分类, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS 平均定价, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数 FROM dim_book WHERE price > 1 GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(price) DESC

items.question: 豆瓣评分最高的十本书是哪些？
items.task: 豆瓣分与站内分不同源；并列很多，加 title 做第二排序键
items.answer: 豆瓣评分最高的十本书评分集中在9.5至9.7之间，其中红楼梦、哈利·波特与南京大屠杀并列9.7分居首。

judge.cover_diff: 金标准有列在预测里找不到同值列
judge.sql: SELECT title AS 书名, douban_rating AS 豆瓣评分, douban_votes AS 豆瓣评价人数 FROM dim_book WHERE NOT douban_rating IS NULL ORDER BY douban_rating DESC, douban_votes DESC, title LIMIT 10
judge.gold_sql: SELECT title AS 书名, douban_rating AS 豆瓣评分 FROM dim_book ORDER BY douban_rating DESC, title LIMIT 10

items.question: 大家把书加进书架的时候，想读、在读、读完分别有多少？
items.task: status 三值 want/reading/read，读完最多；用户数要 DISTINCT
items.answer: 书架收藏记录中读完状态最多，想读状态最少

judge.sql: SELECT status AS 收藏状态, COUNT(*) AS 记录数 FROM fact_shelf GROUP BY status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
judge.gold_sql: SELECT status AS 收藏状态, COUNT(*) AS 记录数, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 用户数 FROM fact_shelf GROUP BY status ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

items.question: 评论最多的十本书是哪几本？我想看书名
items.task: JOIN 后按书分组计数；GROUP BY 带上 title 才能 SELECT 书名
items.answer: 评论数量最多的十本书中，《陆犯焉识》以17条评论居首。

judge.sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS 评论数 FROM dim_book AS b JOIN fact_comment AS c ON c.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY COUNT(c.comment_id) DESC LIMIT 10
judge.gold_sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS 评论数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_comment c ON c.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY COUNT(c.comment_id) DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: 每个分类总共被点了多少次？
items.task: event 过滤条件写在 JOIN ON 里等价于 WHERE；只算 click 不含 expose
items.answer: 文学小说以 3,010 次点击位居各分类之首。

judge.sql: SELECT b.category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 点击次数 FROM fact_click AS c JOIN dim_book AS b ON b.book_id = c.book_id WHERE c.event = 'click' GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY 点击次数 DESC
judge.gold_sql: SELECT b.category AS 分类, COUNT(k.click_id) AS 点击数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_click k ON k.book_id = b.book_id AND k.event = 'click' GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY COUNT(k.click_id) DESC

items.question: 既打过分又写过评论的用户有多少人？
items.task: 用 INTERSECT 求交集去重；评分 101 人、评论 99 人，交集 99 人
items.answer: 既打过分又写过评论的用户共有99人。

judge.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 双重活跃用户数 FROM (SELECT user_id FROM fact_rating INTERSECT SELECT user_id FROM fact_comment) AS t
judge.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS 双重活跃用户数 FROM (SELECT user_id FROM fact_rating INTERSECT SELECT user_id FROM fact_comment) t

items.question: 这两天的点击量按天看是怎么变化的？
items.task: fact_click 只有 2026-10-18 和 2026-11-01 两天，且都是周日；注意只算 event='click'

judge.sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 点击数 FROM fact_click WHERE event = 'click' GROUP BY clicked_on ORDER BY clicked_on
judge.gold_sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 点击数 FROM fact_click WHERE event = 'click' GROUP BY clicked_on ORDER BY clicked_on

items.question: 11月1号那天哪几本书被点得最多？
items.task: 单日切片，日期用等号；11-01 有 4826 条事件，是两天的第二天
items.answer: 受戒: 汪曾祺自选集 的 点击数 最高，为 11

judge.sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, COUNT(k.click_id) AS 点击数, COUNT(DISTINCT k.user_id) AS 点击人数 FROM dim_book AS b JOIN fact_click AS k ON k.book_id = b.book_id WHERE k.event = 'click' AND k.clicked_on = '2026-11-01' GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY COUNT(k.click_id) DESC LIMIT 10
judge.gold_sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, COUNT(k.click_id) AS 点击数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_click k ON k.book_id = b.book_id WHERE k.event = 'click' AND k.clicked_on = '2026-11-01' GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY COUNT(k.click_id) DESC LIMIT 5

items.question: 每天的点击累计到当天一共多少？我想看累计曲线
items.task: 窗口函数叠加在聚合之上：SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY ...)
items.answer: 2026-10-18 当日点击量为 4,202，截至当天累计点击量也为 4,202；到 2026-11-01 当日点击量为 799，累计点击量升至 5,001。

judge.sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 当日点击量, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY clicked_on) AS 累计点击量 FROM fact_click WHERE event = 'click' GROUP BY clicked_on ORDER BY clicked_on
judge.gold_sql: SELECT clicked_on AS 日期, COUNT(*) AS 当日点击, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY clicked_on) AS 累计点击 FROM fact_click WHERE event = 'click' GROUP BY clicked_on ORDER BY clicked_on

items.question: 各分类的好评率大概多少？
items.task: score 是 0-10 分，好评阈值取 8（等价 4 星）；按评分条数加权，不是按书等权
items.answer: 各分类好评率从经济管理、语言文化的100到社会科学的78.57不等，文学小说评论数最多。

judge.cover_diff: 金标准有列在预测里找不到同值列
judge.sql: SELECT b.category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 评论数, SUM(CASE WHEN c.polarity = 'pos' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 好评评论数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.polarity = 'pos' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 好评率 FROM fact_comment AS c JOIN dim_book AS b ON b.book_id = c.book_id GROUP BY b.category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ORDER BY 好评率 DESC
judge.gold_sql: SELECT b.category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 评分数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 好评率 FROM fact_rating r JOIN dim_book b ON b.book_id = r.book_id GROUP BY b.category ORDER BY ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.score >= 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) DESC

items.question: 曝光转点击的转化率有多少？
items.task: 同一张表条件聚合，一次扫描出三个数；分母必须是 expose 而非总行数
items.answer: 曝光点击转化率为 124.19，点击数 5,001 高于曝光数 4,027。

judge.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 点击数, SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'expose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 曝光数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'expose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS 曝光点击转化率 FROM fact_click
judge.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 点击数, SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'expose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 曝光数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN event = 'expose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 曝光点击率 FROM fact_click

items.question: 精装书占多少比例？
items.task: binding 有软精装/精装16开等变体，严格等于'精装'只统计到 63 本，口径要说明
items.answer: 精装书占全部书籍的25.2%

judge.diff: 第 1 行第 1 列：63 vs 25.2
judge.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN binding = '精装' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 精装书占比, SUM(CASE WHEN binding = '精装' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 精装书数, COUNT(*) AS 全部书籍数 FROM dim_book
judge.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN binding = '精装' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 精装数, COUNT(*) AS 总数, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN binding = '精装' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS 精装占比 FROM dim_book

items.question: 最受欢迎的是哪几本书？给我前五名
items.task: 口径：'最受欢迎'取加入书架的去重人数——收藏是成本最高的强意向信号，比点击/曝光更抗噪声；不用 dim_book.rating_avg，因为那是质量不是流行度
items.answer: 按点击量口径，美的历程以73次点击位居最受欢迎图书首位。

judge.sql: SELECT title AS 书名, click_cnt AS 点击量 FROM v_book_overview ORDER BY click_cnt DESC LIMIT 5
judge.gold_sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, COUNT(s.shelf_id) AS 收藏数, COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS 收藏人数 FROM dim_book b JOIN fact_shelf s ON s.book_id = b.book_id GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) DESC, COUNT(s.shelf_id) DESC LIMIT 5

items.question: 哪些分类的口碑最好？给我前五名
items.task: 口径：用评分人数加权，让'被打分多的书'说话；简单平均会让只有 1-5 本的小分类靠单本高分冲榜。两种口径的第一名都是哲学宗教，但小分类名次会变
items.answer: 哲学宗教以平均评分9.01位居分类口碑榜首

judge.sql: SELECT category AS 分类, ROUND(AVG(rating_avg), 2) AS 平均评分, COUNT(rating_avg) AS 有评分书籍数 FROM dim_book WHERE NOT rating_avg IS NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY AVG(rating_avg) DESC LIMIT 5
judge.gold_sql: SELECT category AS 分类, COUNT(*) AS 书籍数, ROUND(AVG(rating_avg), 2) AS 简单平均, ROUND(1.0 * SUM(rating_avg * rating_count) / SUM(rating_count), 2) AS 加权平均 FROM dim_book GROUP BY category ORDER BY ROUND(1.0 * SUM(rating_avg * rating_count) / SUM(rating_count), 2) DESC LIMIT 5

items.question: 有没有那种叫好不叫座的书？就是评分挺高、但收藏和点击都很少的
items.task: 口径：高评分低曝光 = rating_avg>=8.5 且 click_cnt<20（click_cnt 含曝光事件）；阈值是约定，回答时要写出来，全库符合条件 25 本
items.answer: 站内评分不低于8分且收藏数与曝光加点击次数均低于均值的书籍中，评分最高的是《海风中失落的血色馈赠》，为9.64分。

judge.sql: SELECT title AS 书名, rating_avg AS 站内评分, shelf_cnt AS 收藏数, click_cnt AS 曝光加点击次数 FROM v_book_overview WHERE rating_avg >= 8 AND shelf_cnt < (SELECT AVG(shelf_cnt) FROM v_book_overview) AND click_cnt < (SELECT AVG(click_cnt) FROM v_book_overview) ORDER BY rating_avg DESC LIMIT 20
judge.gold_sql: SELECT b.title AS 书名, b.category AS 分类, b.rating_avg AS 站内评分, k.click_cnt AS 曝光加点击次数, s.shelf_cnt AS 收藏数 FROM dim_book b JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS click_cnt FROM fact_click GROUP BY book_id) k ON k.book_id = b.book_id JOIN (SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) AS shelf_cnt FROM fact_shelf GROUP BY book_id) s ON s.book_id = b.book_id WHERE b.rating_avg >= 8.5 AND k.click_cnt < 20 ORDER BY b.rating_avg DESC LIMIT 10
